text: What if you hung from a bar for just thirty seconds every day?
A dead hang trains your grip and forearms, while your lats and shoulders hold you up.
That grip carries over to every pull-up, every deadlift, every heavy carry.
Grab the bar about shoulder width, thumbs wrapped around.
Arms straight, ribs down, legs together. Relax into it, and breathe.
After thirty days, a stronger grip, an easier overhead reach, and shoulders that feel less stiff.
Thirty seconds a day. Save this.
